tools.name: create_public_preview
tools.description: Turn a complete standalone HTML document already created in this chat into a temporary, read-only 2ools preview. Free and authless; expires after 24 hours. This tool does not generate the page—write the HTML first, then call it.

tools.name: list_build_systems
tools.description: List the Curators, Rulebooks, and Skills this paid account may explicitly apply. Use before build_from_conversation when the user names a creative system or asks what is available.

tools.name: build_from_conversation
tools.description: Create a new 2ools project from a structured conversation brief and queue one durable build. Returns project_id and job_id; use get_build to retrieve completion status and the protected preview.

tools.name: refine_project
tools.description: Create one protected child version from a saved base version and concrete review feedback. Preserves the base source as currentCode, consumes one persisted project iteration, and returns an asynchronous job_id.

tools.name: get_build
tools.description: Get one build's current status, progress, errors, completed version IDs, and protected preview URLs. Does not return generated source code.

tools.name: compare_versions
tools.description: Compare two saved versions in one project without returning source. Reports lineage, review state, page additions/removals, byte sizes, and SHA-256 identity for each page.

tools.name: list_approval_requests
tools.description: List exact saved versions waiting for a separately delegated reviewer. Returns project/version identity and attribution, never generated source.

tools.name: approve_version
tools.description: Use separately delegated review authority to approve one saved version and make it the project's active version. Does not publish, export, or change project permissions.

tools.name: reject_version
tools.description: Use separately delegated review authority to reject one saved version. If it is active, restores its saved parent as active; the rejected version remains in immutable history.

tools.name: cancel_build
tools.description: Cancel a queued or running non-Agent 2ools build. Completed versions are not deleted and terminal builds are left unchanged. Governed Agent execution uses cancel_agent_run.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List recent 2ools projects the authenticated account can access, including owned and shared projects. Returns compact metadata without generated source.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Get a 2ools project's brief, selected pages, active version, and compact version history. Does not return generated source code.

tools.name: get_project_context
tools.description: Read one source-free operating packet before acting: the active version, exact frozen Curator snapshot, revision-safe Rulebook context, review attention, artifact index, work queue, and current activity cursor. Historical Rulebook text is never guessed after its revision changes.

tools.name: render_project_preview
tools.description: Render an interactive, read-only card for one saved 2ools version. Use after get_build or get_project when the user wants to see, open, or share the result. Returns protected preview and access-checked workspace links without source code.

tools.name: list_project_agents
tools.description: List the authorizing account's built-in Agents assigned to one readable project. This reveals status and summary, not full Limits or run traces.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: Read one Agent's saved Limits, trigger, immutable revision summaries, and redacted append-only run traces. Raw prompts, tool arguments, credentials, and source bytes are not returned.

tools.name: run_project_agent
tools.description: Queue real execution for a project-linked Agent the person already test-ran and armed. The immutable saved Limits, project access, account fuse, and online Engine requirement are enforced server-side before a job exists.

tools.name: cancel_agent_run
tools.description: Stop one queued or running Agent execution and close its durable run history. Completed, failed, stalled, and already-canceled runs keep their terminal truth.

tools.name: get_project_activity
tools.description: Read the attributable project timeline across human work, external MCP agents, builds, versions, feedback, and workspace pins. Actor kind is explicit; an external agent is never presented as the human account that authorized it.

tools.name: wait_for_project_activity
tools.description: Wait up to 20 seconds for attributable project events newer than a head_cursor or prior next_cursor. Returns events oldest-first so an outside agent can process them in order. If resync_required is true, paginate get_project_activity instead of advancing the cursor.

tools.name: list_project_feedback
tools.description: Read page-anchored review feedback for versions in a project, with explicit human or external-agent attribution.

tools.name: add_project_feedback
tools.description: Add an attributable review comment to a saved project version. This does not modify source or approve the version.

tools.name: resolve_project_feedback
tools.description: Owner-only review decision that resolves or reopens one saved feedback item.

tools.name: list_project_pins
tools.description: Read shared workspace notes and http(s) links, with explicit attribution.

tools.name: add_project_pin
tools.description: Add an attributable note or safe http(s) link to the shared project workspace.

tools.name: remove_project_pin
tools.description: Remove one shared workspace pin. The operation is idempotent.

tools.name: prepare_version_export
tools.description: Create a five-minute download URL for an exact saved version. Source is delivered by the download route, never embedded in MCP model output.

tools.name: list_artifacts
tools.description: List durable project artifacts and each latest immutable version without returning stored bytes.

tools.name: get_artifact
tools.description: Read one artifact's immutable version history, provenance, attribution, digests, and review states without returning stored bytes.

tools.name: prepare_artifact_upload
tools.description: Create a five-minute PUT URL for exact bytes. External-agent output always enters pending review and never replaces the current artifact version before approval.

tools.name: prepare_artifact_download
tools.description: Create a five-minute download URL for one immutable artifact version. Stored bytes never enter MCP model output.

tools.name: list_artifact_approval_requests
tools.description: List exact artifact versions awaiting or carrying a human review decision. Requires separately delegated artifact review authority.

tools.name: approve_artifact_version
tools.description: Approve one pending immutable artifact version and make it current. Repeating the same decision is idempotent.

tools.name: reject_artifact_version
tools.description: Reject one pending immutable artifact version with useful feedback. Repeating the same decision is idempotent.

tools.name: list_work_assignments
tools.description: List durable project work contracts, bounded attempts, leases, budgets, and result references.

tools.name: create_work_assignment
tools.description: Create a durable assignment with acceptance criteria and hard step, time, and spend ceilings.

tools.name: claim_work_assignment
tools.description: Atomically claim one open assignment and receive a five-minute renewable lease plus an immutable budget snapshot.

tools.name: heartbeat_work_session
tools.description: Renew the authenticated worker's active lease without widening its immutable step, time, or spend ceilings.

tools.name: submit_work_session
tools.description: End the authenticated worker's lease and submit typed result references for a separate review decision.

tools.name: decide_work_assignment
tools.description: Complete submitted work or reopen it with useful feedback. Requires separately delegated work-review authority.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_public_preview, get_build, get_project_context, list_project_feedback, get_artifact, list_artifact_approval_requests · Private data: create_public_preview, get_agent · Public sink: approve_version, render_project_preview, prepare_artifact_upload, submit_work_session · Destructive: list_project_agents, get_agent, run_project_agent, cancel_agent_run, add_project_feedback, remove_project_pin.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_public_preview, get_build, get_project_context, list_project_feedback, get_artifact, list_artifact_approval_requests · Private data: create_public_preview, get_agent · Public sink: approve_version, render_project_preview, prepare_artifact_upload, submit_work_session · Destructive: list_project_agents, get_agent, run_project_agent, cancel_agent_run, add_project_feedback, remove_project_pin

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
